description: Federal grants and cooperative agreements (award types 02-05, F001, F002) from api.usaspending.gov, queried live over the full dataset (October 2007 on); in an outage, a recent cached window (source 'cache'). award_amount and total_outlays may be null (not reported), not $0. total_count is USAspending's count for the whole query. Detail: keyvex.com/docs/tools/get_federal_grants

awarding_agency.description: Exact, case-sensitive TOPTIER name, e.g. 'Department of Energy' (not 'DOE').

recipient_name.description: Case-insensitive substring; also matches parent names.

recipient_uei.description: 12 characters; that UEI's own grants only.

since.description: YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive, on last_modified_date, or start_date if sorted by it.

name: get_federal_grants
